sections.title: What the controllers do, as found
lines: The upstairs floor heating loop fits a curve with supply 25.9 C at 0 C outdoor and a slope of 0.02 C per C, with a summer stop above 54.1 C outdoor.
The downstairs radiators loop fits a curve with supply 33.3 C at 0 C outdoor and a slope of -1.07 C per C, with a summer stop above 13.8 C outdoor.
The kitchen room responds to the upstairs loop with a held-out error of 0.687 C, and the fireplace and TV rooms respond to the downstairs loop with held-out errors of 0.359 C and 0.263 C.

The data could not separate the downstairs loop's direct heating coupling between the fireplace and TV rooms, as the heating shares are 0.886 and 0.114 but the best model on cold weeks is no control with a runner-up delta BIC of 6.97.
The data could not separate whether the TV room warms on evenings from the people in it, as the operator belief is not supported by the room data alone.
All findings are from logged data and simulation, not from changes or tests on the building.

sections.title: How sure we are
lines: On weeks the fit never saw, the upstairs floor heating curve predicted kitchen temperature with a held-out error of 0.687 C, and the downstairs radiators curve predicted fireplace and tv temperatures with held-out errors of 0.359 C and 0.263 C.
The upstairs curve scored 28.5 on the model-comparison score against no control, which is strong, while the downstairs curve scored -6.0, which is not better than no control.
The spot readings changed with the number of readings used: the error against other panel readings was 12.33 C with 0 readings used, 7.09 C with 1, 6.03 C with 2, 2.19 C with 3, and 2.23 C with 4.

The operator belief that L2 is the same curve as L1 with a flat reduction was refuted because the gap widens as it gets colder, and the belief that the TV room warms on evenings from the people in it was not supported by the room data alone.
The site context programs all scored worse than the blind best, with delta_bic_vs_blind_best values of 9.69, 14.14, 16.27, 10.98, 12.07, 18.37, and 22.6, and one target 'L眼见1' was unknown.
The controller's own outdoor sensor minus the weather station ranged from 0.2 C to 1.1 C across the six values 0.2, 0.7, 0.7, 1.1, 0.4, 0.4.
The data could not tell whether the controller was changed or tested on the building; everything is from logged data and simulation.
The next observation is a fresh Home Assistant pull covering the heating season since the last pull.

sections.title: What the data cannot tell yet
lines: The outdoor data covers only -1.6 C to 28.8 C, so the curve is unobserved outside that range.
The data cannot separate a level change from a slope change in the curves.
Some mechanisms fit the data but are not supported: the TV room warming from people is not supported by the room data alone.
The synthetic benchmark used 6 cases and each arm got the right mechanism 1 time, so it cannot confirm any mechanism on this building.
Everything here is from logged data and simulation, not from any change or test on the building.

sections.title: Next observation
lines: The next observation is a fresh Home Assistant pull covering the heating season since the last pull.
It would settle whether the logged weeks used here still represent the season as a whole.

sections.title: Yhteenveto huoltomiehelle (suomeksi)
lines: Yläkerran lattialämmitys (keittiö) noudattaa käyrää: menovesi 25.9 °C ulkolämpötilassa 0 °C, kulmakerroin 0.02 °C/°C, kesäpysäytys yli 54.1 °C.
Alakerran patterit (takka, tv) noudattavat eri käyrää: menovesi 33.3 °C ulkolämpötilassa 0 °C, kulmakerroin -1.07 °C/°C, kesäpysäytys yli 13.8 °C.
Kylmien viikkojen aineistossa alakerran paras malli oli 'S0 No control (free-floating)', joten säätimen vaikutus ei ole varma.
Säätimen oma ulkoanturi näyttää 0.2–1.1 °C enemmän kuin FMI Kouvola Utti lentoasema (fmisid 101191).
Paneelilta kannattaa seuraavaksi lukea menoveden lämpötila ja ulkolämpötila, ja verrata niitä yllä oleviin lukuihin.
Seuraava tarkistus on uusi Home Assistant -haku, joka kattaa lämmityskauden edellisen haun jälkeen.

glossary.delta_bic_curve_over_no_control: model-comparison score: how much better the curve explains the room data than no control, after a complexity penalty. Over 10 is strong. NOT energy, NOT degrees.
glossary.held_out_error_c: prediction error of room temperature on weeks the fit never saw, degrees C
glossary.heating_share_by_room: each room's share of the loop's direct heating coupling, 0 to 1
glossary.error_vs_other_panel_readings_c: how far the fitted curve is from panel supply readings not used in the fit, degrees C
glossary.controller_sensor_minus_fmi_c: controller's own outdoor sensor minus the weather station, degrees C
glossary.delta_bic_vs_blind_best: positive = worse than the best program found without site context; over 2 is a real difference
glossary.next_observation: the cheapest next check, already chosen by the system - report it, do not invent another
